title: Grafana dashboards that lead to a decision

questions.question: What makes a dashboard panel useful?
options: It supports a specific operational decision and next step
questions.explanation: A panel is useful when someone can act on it during operation or review.

questions.question: Where should a high-cardinality correlation ID usually go?
options: A log or trace field with safe access
questions.explanation: Metrics labels must be bounded. Logs and traces are better for request-level identifiers.
